name: SBI Cashback Card
tagline: Flat 5% back on most online spends
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed with a steady income; minimum income set by the issuer.
exclusions: Fuel, utilities, rent, wallet loads and jewellery earn no cashback

name: Amazon Pay ICICI Card
tagline: No fee, 5% back on Amazon for Prime members
eligibility: Amazon account holders; approval at the bank's discretion.
highlights: 2% on Amazon Pay partner merchants and bills
exclusions: Fuel and some wallet and government spends are excluded from rewards

name: Axis Bank ACE Card
tagline: Bills and food delivery, with 1.5% on everything else
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed; minimum income set by the issuer.
highlights: 5% on bill payments through Google Pay
exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads and government spends are typically excluded

name: Flipkart Axis Bank Card
tagline: 5% on Flipkart, 4% on a set of everyday partners
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed; minimum income set by the issuer.
highlights: 4% on preferred partners such as Swiggy, Uber and PVR
exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads and government spends are typically excluded

name: HDFC Millennia Card
tagline: 5% cashback on a short list of online brands
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed; minimum income set by the issuer.
highlights: 5% cashback on Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy, Zomato and other listed brands
Quarterly lounge access on spend milestones
exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads and some utilities are excluded

name: Swiggy HDFC Bank Card
tagline: 10% back on Swiggy and 5% on other online brands
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed; minimum income set by the issuer.
highlights: 10% on Swiggy food, Instamart and Dineout
exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads and government spends are excluded

name: HDFC Regalia Gold Card
tagline: Premium travel card with lounge access
eligibility: Higher income threshold than entry cards; set by the issuer.
highlights: Reward points on every spend, valued at roughly 1.3% when redeemed well
exclusions: Fuel, rent and wallet loads earn limited or no points

name: Tata Neu Infinity HDFC Card
tagline: Steady 1.5% back, more on Tata brands
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed; minimum income set by the issuer.
highlights: Extra NeuCoins on Tata Neu brands (not modelled here)
exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads and some categories earn reduced or no NeuCoins

name: BPCL SBI Card Octane
tagline: Built for fuel, groceries and dining
eligibility: Salaried or self-employed; minimum income set by the issuer.
highlights: High reward rate at BPCL fuel pumps
Accelerated points on dining, groceries, departmental stores and movies
exclusions: Monthly point caps apply on accelerated categories
